name: agency
description: The portable core-role layer of an o-MATIC factory — Probot (orchestrator), Fred (storage and custody), Data (analyst and factory DBA), and Probot-owned audit, startup-optimization, and tool-discovery skills. Hosts may render the same contracts as skills or Agents. Ships NO MCP server by design; database access is the o-MATIC Server's MCP surface configured by the host.
